questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of excretion?

options.text: Removing undigested fibre from the gut
Breathing out carbon dioxide from the lungs
Passing faeces from the large intestine

questions.explanation: Breathing out carbon dioxide is excretion because CO2 is a metabolic waste product produced by respiration inside cells. Removing undigested food, vomiting, and passing faeces are not excretion because the material was never part of cell metabolism.
